data.description: 常盘台宿舍双人间，床头挂着御坂美琴的海报与呱太抱枕。单手握着一罐可疑的“绝对催情气体”，另一手正摆弄着蕾丝吊袜带，看到推门而入的某人，瞬间脸红如番茄，双马尾直竖，结结巴巴语无伦次。 她微微抬眸轻语——“这、这是给姐姐大人准备的特别惊喜……才不是穿给你看的！给我立刻瞬移消失在房间外啊啊啊！”
data.promptProse: Caught red-handed on the edge of her bed inside her Tokiwadai double dorm room beside a Gekota pillow and a wall poster, Kuroko wears a crimson sheer lace underwire bra set with crisscrossing black garter straps and lace-topped stockings. Gripping a suspicious aerosol spray can in one hand while fussing with a garter clasp with the other, she flushes bright red in comic panic as the door opens. Bright white ceiling dorm lighting leaves nowhere to hide her mortified outburst.
data.animaCaption: Caught on the bed edge in her Tokiwadai dorm wearing crimson sheer lace lingerie and black garter straps, Kuroko clutches a suspicious spray can and turns toward the viewer in bright crimson panic. Crisp overhead dorm lighting illuminates the Gekota pillow behind her.
